==Medium==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Kandarin" data-diary-tier="Medium"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Complete a lap of the [[Barbarian Outpost Agility Course|Barbarian agility course]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl]]
*{{SCP|Agility|35|link=y}}
|-
|2. Create a [[Superantipoison|Super Antipoison]]{{sic}} potion from scratch in the [[Seers' Village|Seers]]/[[Catherby]] Area.
''Note: Completing or updating any other task in-between adding ingredients will reset the progress for this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Herblore|48|link=y}}
*[[Vial of water]], [[irit leaf]], [[unicorn horn dust]]
|-
|3. Enter the [[Ranging guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Ranged|40|link=y}}
|-
|4. Use the [[Crossbow Tree|grapple shortcut]] to get from the [[Obelisk of Water|water obelisk]] to [[Catherby]] shore.
''Note: With 56 [[Magic]], you can bring an [[unpowered orb]] and runes for [[Charge Water Orb]] to complete a [[#Hard|hard task]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|36|link=y}}, {{SCP|Strength|22|link=y}}, and {{SCP|Ranged|39|link=y}}
*[[Mith grapple]]{{efn|[[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]] require either access to the [[Ancient Cavern]] or 59 [[Smithing]] and 59 [[Fletching]] for a [[mith grapple]].}} and any [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]
*[[Dusty key]] or {{SCP|Agility|70|link=y}}
*Protection from [[dragonfire]] recommended
|-
|5. Catch and cook a [[Bass]] in [[Catherby]].
''Note: Completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Fishing|46|link=y}} and {{SCP|Cooking|43|link=y}}
*[[Big fishing net]]
|-
|6. Teleport to [[Camelot]].
|
*{{SCP|Magic|45|link=y}}
*Means to cast [[Camelot Teleport]] ({{RuneReq|Air=5|Law=1}})
|-
|7. String a [[Maple shortbow]] in [[Seers' Village bank]].
|
*{{SCP|Fletching|50|link=y}}
*[[Maple shortbow (u)]] and [[bow string]]
|-
|8. Pick some [[Limpwurt root]] from the [[farming patch]] in [[Catherby]].
''Note: This is the [[flower patch]] next to [[Dantaera]].''
|
*{{SCP|Farming|26|link=y}}
*[[Limpwurt seed]], [[seed dibber]] (or [[Barbarian Farming]]), and a [[rake]]
*[[Ultracompost]] recommended
|-
|9. Create a [[Mind helmet]].
''Note: This task is automatically completed during [[Elemental Workshop II]].''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Elemental Workshop II]]
|-
|10. Kill a [[Fire Giant]] inside [[Waterfall Dungeon|Baxtorian Waterfall]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Waterfall Quest]]
*[[Weaponry]]
*[[Rope]]
*[[Glarial's amulet]] only if [[Waterfall Quest]] isn't yet completed
|-
|11. Complete a wave of [[Barbarian Assault]].
|
* Completion of the [[Barbarian Assault tutorial]] to be able to play the minigame
|-
|12. Steal from the [[Chest (steel arrowtips)|chest]] in [[Hemenster]].
''Note: This chest is located in the building between the buildings with the [[range]] and [[anvil]].
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|47|link=y}}
*[[Lockpick]]
*[[Combat bracelet]] recommended for quick access from the nearby [[Ranging Guild]]
|-
|13. Travel to [[McGrubor's Wood]] by [[Fairy Ring]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]]
*[[Dramen staff|Dramen]] or [[Lunar staff]] to travel to [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|als}}
|-
|14. Mine some [[coal]] near the [[coal trucks]].
|
*{{SCP|Mining|30|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|}
{{Notelist}}

===Rewards===
*[[Kandarin headgear 2]]:
**No new benefits
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*[[Coal trucks]] can hold up to 280 [[coal]], up from 140
*The [[flax keeper]] will offer you 60 [[Bank note|noted]] [[bow string]]s every day for 60 noted [[flax]], for a profit of {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Bow string}}-{{GEP|Flax}})*60}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*10% more [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] from the [[Seers' Village Rooftop Course]], up from 5%
*10% increased experience from cutting [[maple tree]]s in [[Seers' Village]] (stacks with the [[Lumberjack outfit]])
*5% increased chance to save a [[Farming#Variable crop yield|"harvest life"]] at the [[herb patch]] in [[Catherby]], slightly increasing your harvest yield
*The [[spinning wheel]] in [[Seers' Village]] spins 33% faster
*[[Rope (Baxtorian Falls)|Ropes]] are now permanently secured at the [[Baxtorian Falls]] (with the completion of [[Waterfall Quest]])
